Chapter 919: Chapter 18: Resurrection (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 919: Chapter 18: Resurrection (Please Subscribe)

“No more sparring?”

Lin Yuan asked.

“There’s no need to continue sparring.” The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss replied.

In fact, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had stronger trump cards and killing moves that he had not yet used.

Even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path in the Origin of the Immortal Realm had not yet made a move.

But through these two probing attacks, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had confirmed that he could not only fail to lock onto Lin Yuan’s location in space-time.

Even the attacks he launched were unable to touch or affect Lin Yuan.

Therefore, continuing to spar was meaningless.

It was completely one-sided output from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Then may I enter the Origin of the Immortal Realm to have a look?” Lin Yuan continued to ask.

“Of course, you may.” The corners of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s mouth twitched slightly. Based on the outcome of his sparring with Lin Yuan, even if he disagreed, it would be of no use.

Lin Yuan could enter the Origin regardless of his permission.

Lin Yuan’s arrival to the Demon Abyss and his encounter with the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss— who couldn’t do anything to him—was all done without a sound.

Similarly, he could enter the Origin of the Immortal Realm just as quietly, and even before the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, he would be helpless.

“Then, thank you very much.” Lin Yuan nodded.

Although he could directly enter the Origin of the Immortal Realm, it was always proper to greet the host.

“I will take my leave now. If there’s anything, just contact me directly.”

After Lin Yuan spoke, his figure directly dissipated, for it was merely an avatar he had sent here. When the will of his mind dissipated, the avatar naturally vanished.

“Ancestor of Martial Arts…”

After Lin Yuan left, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss stood for a long time before he sighed and disappeared as well.

The sparring between the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss and Lin Yuan caused a profound impact in the Demon Abyss, leaving countless demonic beings and their emperors in fear and unrest.

Since their creation, they had never felt the Father God exert such force, stirring up spatial-temporal fluctuations that affected the entire Demon Abyss.

…

Xuantian Immortal Domain.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Twelfth Layer strength…” Lin Yuan carefully sensed the two strikes unleashed by the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss just now.

Although in terms of space-time, Lin Yuan was superior to the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, making him innately invincible, it was still just invincibility.

If he were to resist head-on, not to mention it was just an avatar, even his true form, the true form from the Main Universe, would not be able to withstand it.

“There’s still a considerable gap between me and the direct combat power of the Twelfth Layer.” Lin Yuan evaluated himself and concluded.

He was only able to survive before the ultimate fighters of the Twelfth Layer, not meaning he could contend against the ultimate Twelfth Layer.

“But compared to those Twelfth Layer powerhouses in the Main Universe, could the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss be considered somewhat weaker?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even within the Twelfth Layer, there are differences in strength—it’s not just about the three big stages: Path Splitting, Domination, and Chaos.

Even within the Path Splitting Realm alone, there is a large gap, and those at the peak of the Path Splitting Twelfth Layer can safely endure the tribulations of the universe’s destruction. The ordinary Path Splitting Twelfth Layer beings, when facing the tribulations of the universe’s destruction, would have to accept a great demise.

It is understandable for the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss to be weaker than the Twelfth Layer powerhouses of the Main Universe.

After all, those Twelfth Layer powerhouses from the Main Universe occasionally spar with each other, competing, and might even receive higher teachings from outside the universe.

But the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss? Being two sides of the same coin with the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, before Lin Yuan descended into the Immortal Realm, had already been invincible for countless years, losing the drive that comes with having enemies and naturally halting in strength advancement.

However, even the weakest of the Twelfth Layer is still ultimate, and Lin Yuan, who has realized the Seventh Realm of space-time, could only survive before them.

“The space-time passage is completely formed now.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking at the space-time passage in front of him.

This was a passage forcibly established between the Immortal Realm and the Spirit Realm based on Lin Yuan’s insight into the Seventh Realm of space-time, condensing space-time.

Such a feat could only be achieved by Lin Yuan. Even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss could at most bring a few lives into the Immortal Realm.

As for creating a stable space-time passage? Almost impossible.

Before long.

Faint figures began to appear within the space-time passage before Lin Yuan.

“Is this, is this the Immortal Realm?”

Li Qing stepped through the lengthy space-time passage, and upon entering the Immortal Realm, she was immersed in the rich Immortal Qi and the extremely complete Dao rules. For a moment, she was lost in astonishment.

In her life, she, Li Qing, actually had a day where she entered the Immortal Realm?

“Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

“Greetings to the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

“Greetings to the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

Behind Li Qing, Shan Yang, Nie Yun, and the rest of the Eighth Layer Martial Tao practitioners steadied their spirits. Upon seeing Lin Yuan, who stood not far away with his hands behind his back, they immediately bowed down fervently.

As the Ancestor of Martial Arts returned to the Spirit Realm and opened a passage to the Immortal Realm, this news had already spread throughout the 3000 Dao regions of the Spirit Realm, driving countless cultivators mad with excitement.

Leaving aside the prospect of entering the legendary Immortal Realm, just the mere sight of the Ancestor of Martial Arts, the Progenitor Originator of Martial Tao, was enough to make all cultivators willing to die for the opportunity.

“Stand up.”

“First, get accustomed to the environment of the Immortal Realm.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, initiating the eighth traverse. Martial Tao was waning in the Spirit Realm, supported only by Li Qing, Shan Yang, and Nie Yun, the three Seventh Stage Martial Tao practitioners.

When Lin Yuan first met Shan Yang, the latter had planned to take Lin Yuan to visit the Nine Heavens.

“Yes.”

“Venerated Martial Ancestor Rank.”

Li Qing, Shan Yang, Nie Yun, and other cultivators of the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao nodded in extreme excitement.

Lin Yuan looked toward the rear, and as Li Qing and the other two Eighth Layer Martial Tao practitioners completed their journey through the Space-Time Passage, more and more cultivators of Martial Tao’s Eighth Layer entered the Immortal Realm.

Among them were Jun Haiqiu, Jun Nangong, and Jun Yunxun from the Jun Family.

In the Central Divine China World, after Lin Yuan’s transmigration, he took the identity of Wuji, a third-generation immortal of the Morality Immortal Sect from the Jun Family, and at that time, the influence of the Jun Family in the Morality Immortal Sect was not insignificant.

…

Spirit Realm.

Lin Yuan’s conjured avatar began to break free from the world’s shackles and arrived outside of the world.

“Central Divine Continent…”

Lin Yuan looked down, the Ling Family possessing a million subordinate worlds, of which the Central Divine Continent World was one.

The distance between the Spirit Realm and the Central Divine Continent was not far, and the Refine Void Period powerhouses from the Central Divine Continent could ascend to the Spirit Realm through the Ascension Platform.

This incarnation of Lin Yuan continued to descend and finally merged with the Central Divine Continent.

“Back again.”

As Lin Yuan observed his surroundings, he immediately felt an extreme ‘narrowness,’ as if the entire Central Divine Continent couldn’t contain his colossal presence.

Whoosh.

To integrate as seamlessly as possible with the Central Divine Continent, Lin Yuan’s wisp of mental will directly inhabited the body that once belonged to Wuji, which he had specifically reserved.

“This world…”

Lin Yuan looked around, the minute details of the Central Divine Continent World falling into his view.

The current Central Divine Continent World had become thoroughly dominated by Martial Tao; perhaps it was the influence of his eighth traversal to the Spirit Realm, the Martial Tao cultivators had become the absolute mainstream in the Central Divine Continent World.

“The River of Time…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze deepened as he looked towards the Central Divine Continent World’s River of Time.

Lin Yuan had descended to the Central Divine Continent World specifically with the intention of resurrecting people such as Jun Dongjin and Mu Lian’er.

Although people like Jun Dongjin had ascended to the Spirit Realm, they were born in the Central Divine Continent World and their life brands were also in the Central Divine Continent World, so to be resurrected, they had to return to the Central Divine Continent World.

“Resurrect.”

Lin Yuan’s form became ethereal, he flowed upstream, starting to lock onto the essences of lives that had perished in the past.

Resurrection techniques belonged to the capabilities of twelfth-tier powerhouses, but fundamentally, it was just a mastery of space and time.

Grasping the entire Rule of Time at the eleventh tier, one could also flow upstream and theoretically scoop up fleeting lives from the past, but one would be unable to withstand the backlash from the River of Time.

Today, Lin Yuan’s life essence was unprecedentedly strong, resurrecting some seven-tier beings was all too simple, not to mention the pittance of a backlash from the River of Time.

Rustle rustle.

The River of Time rippled, one after another, gray life brands were scooped up and then brought to the current space-time.

“I, I thought I was dead?”

Jun Dongjin, Mu Lian’er, Jun Xiaoyao, Jun Zhilan, and others blinked, finding it rather unbelievable, their memories all halting at the final moment of death.

Now that they were resurrected, it was as if they had just awoken from sleep.

“I feel that, my lifespan has become immeasurably extended, I could live for at least a million or ten million years,” Jun Dongjin took a deep breath.

He remembered that he didn’t have much lifespan left, so how come his lifespan has now surged by a hundredfold?

“Me too.”

Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Zhilan looked at each other, “Is this Central Divine Continent? I remember I had already entered the Spirit Realm through the Ascension Platform.”

“Wuji!” Mu Lian’er suddenly called out excitedly.

The family turned their heads and saw Lin Yuan quietly observing, his aura as constrained as possible, otherwise people like Jun Dongjin wouldn’t even have the qualification to look at him directly.

“Don’t panic, you have been resurrected by me…”

Lin Yuan explained with a smile, “Next, I will take you to the Immortal Realm.”

Resurrecting Jun Dongjin and his family was an effortless matter for Lin Yuan; after all, it was no trouble for him, and it required no price to be paid.

Besides Jun Dongjin’s family, Lin Yuan resurrected many others, such as the parents of his eighth traversal’s Spirit Realm fleshly form, and so on.

Given the strength of Lin Yuan’s life essence, even resurrecting eleventh-tier lives was well within his capability, and reviving many more ordinary lives was just a matter of thought.

After resurrection, Lin Yuan slightly infused each resurrected being with some Origin Source, greatly prolonging their lifespans.

Otherwise, lives that died due to the limit of their lifespan, even if pieced back together, would still have to face the issue of lifespan limitation.

“We’ve been resurrected?” The hearts of Jun Dongjin’s family were shaken; they had been to the Spirit Realm and knew that even for a Tribulation Stage Celestial King, death was final, and the notion of resurrection didn’t exist.

And yet, Wuji could effortlessly resurrect them? And it wasn’t a mere resurrection, their life essence, the length of their lifespan, had all been significantly elevated?

“Immortal Realm?” Jun Xiaoyao was momentarily stunned, could they really proceed to the Immortal Realm?

…

Resurrecting long-gone relatives and friends was a task for a negligibly minor incarnation split by Lin Yuan.

As for his true body, it remained in closed-door cultivation, comprehending the Dao.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness immersed in the depths of his mind, gazing towards the towering and grandiose Myriad Realms Gate.

Now with the attainment of the Seventh Realm in space-time comprehension, this was Lin Yuan’s first examination of the Myriad Realms Gate.

“What is this?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly.

At this moment, with his space-time insight reaching the Seventh Realm, he immediately noticed changes in the Myriad Realms Gate.
